title: 2017 AMC 10A Problem 9
statement: Minnie rides on a flat road at \(20\) kilometers per hour (kph), downhill at \(30\) kph, and uphill at \(5\) kph. Penny rides on a flat road at \(30\) kph, downhill at \(40\) kph, and uphill at \(10\) kph. Minnie goes from town \(A\) to town \(B,\) a distance of \(10\) km all uphill, then from town \(B\) to town \(C,\) a distance of \(15\) km all downhill, and then back to town \(A,\) a distance of \(20\) km on the flat. Penny goes the other way around using the same route. How many more minutes does it take Minnie to complete the \(45\)-km ride than it takes Penny?

solutions.text:
It will take Minnie \(10 \div 5 = 2\) hours to travel the uphill distance. It will take her \(15 \div 30 = \frac{1}{2}\) hours to travel the downhill distance.

Finally, it will take her \(20 \div 20 = 1\) hour to travel the flat. This will take her a total of \[ \begin{aligned}60\left(2 + \frac{1}{2} + 1\right) &= 60 \cdot \frac{7}{2} \\&= 210 \end{aligned}\] minutes.

It will take Penny \(20 \div 30 = \frac{2}{3}\) hours to travel the flat. It will take her another \(15 \div 10 = \frac{3}{2}\) hours to travel the uphill.

Finally, it will take her \(10 \div 40 = \frac{1}{4}\) hours to travel the downhill. This is a total of \[\begin{aligned} 60\left(\dfrac{2}{3} + \dfrac{3}{2} + \dfrac{1}{4}\right) &= 60 \cdot \dfrac{29}{12} \\&= 145 \end{aligned}\] minutes. The trip takes Minnie \(210 - 145 = 65\) more minutes to travel than Penny.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Compute Minnie’s three segment times in hours
Compute Penny’s three segment times on the same route in the opposite direction
